Draw. Add shapes. Text. Colors.

Save to Copper. Or Copy Paste straight to your prompt composer.

item.title: The shadcn cli can now read registries config out of package.json. Which means if you're distributing non-component code,
item.author: @shadcn
item.description:
The shadcn cli can now read registries config out of package.json. Which means if you're distributing non-component code, no components.json required.

It works with everything else: add, search, view.

Any project can now install code from registries.
